name: Stabilising and Recovery
summary: A creature within reach can use an action and succeed on a DC 10 Medicine check to stabilise a dying creature. Field dressings, med-packs and class features may improve this. Ordinary hit-point recovery follows the normal rest rules; lasting injuries, surgery and limb replacement use Chapter 19.
